reviewer: Claude Code (AI assistant). Not an independent human review.
method: Three-paper reuse families, round-two phrase searches on all 1,587 pages, reading of every printing, and scan checks of each admitted passage
scan_scope: Each crop covers the excerpt, the opening of the printed item. Long documents were not proofread in full.

new_groups.label: Opening of Congress, November 1797
new_groups.definition: Printings of Adams's speech opening the second session of the Fifth Congress (23 November 1797), the Senate's and House's answers, and his reply to the House.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Special session of Congress, 1797
new_groups.definition: The special session of 1797: Adams's summoning proclamation (25 March), his speech (16 May) and the House's answer. Contains the speech, proclamation and answer groups.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Proclamation summoning Congress
new_groups.definition: Printings of Adams's proclamation of 25 March 1797 convening Congress on 15 May.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: House's answer to the special-session speech
new_groups.definition: Printings of the House of Representatives' answer to Adams's speech of 16 May 1797, in draft and final form.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Hermione mutiny
new_groups.definition: Reports of the mutiny on the British frigate Hermione (September 1797) and her delivery to the Spanish at La Guaira: first rumours, the detailed 'Particulars', and a follow-up.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: 'Particulars of the mutiny'
new_groups.definition: Printings of the detailed account of the Hermione mutiny first printed in Philadelphia on 16 November 1797.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Quito earthquake
new_groups.definition: Printings of a Quito account (6 February 1797), via Jamaica, of the earthquake of 4 February.
new_groups.admission_rule: Reviewed 1797 printings, checked against the scan.

new_groups.label: Kościuszko's land warrant

new_groups.label: Jefferson's letter to Madison

new_groups.label: Barney escapes the blockade

new_groups.label: Sonthonax leaves Saint-Domingue

new_groups.label: French captures at Havana

new_groups.label: New Hampshire governor's address
